tank_description: A long-range marksman armed with a hard-hitting cannon and exceptional mobility. Able to trap enemies, mark targets for execution, and strike from unexpected angles, it rewards patience, positioning, and precise aim.

strengths.title: High Mobility
strengths.description: Fast and agile, The Leo1a6 can move rapidly across maps allowing it to take up advantageous positions, exploit flanks, and change between firing positions at will.

strengths.title: High Alpha Damage
strengths.description: The Leo1a6 Boasts excellent single-shot damage, Especially if a shot scores a critical hit. Players who take the time to aim for modules will find almost every shot can cause crippling damage.

strengths.title: Lethal Ultimate
strengths.description: Whilst not truly unique to this tank. Hounds agent has an ultimate that adds to the Leo1a6's lethality significantly. A module paring with trapping shot allows precise Hound players the ability to score some truly impressive kill streaks.

strengths.title: Damage Cone
strengths.description: The Leo1a6 has one of the best damage cones in the game allowing for critical hits in most cases where other tanks couldn't. Coupled with knowledge of internal modules, even head on players can be punished.

weaknesses.title: Non Existent Armour
weaknesses.description: The armour on the leo1a6 is virtually paper-thin and is only sufficient to occasionally resist frontal HE or auto-cannon penetration; against most threats, protection is largely negligible. Coupled with large critical modules behind token armour means caught Leo1a6 players end up dead, quicky.

weaknesses.title: Poor HP Pool
weaknesses.description: With just 2,060 HP, The Leo1a6 currently has one of the lowest health pool in the game, leaving little room for mistakes which can force a very passive playstyle from its commanders and makes you play more around your team than with it.

weaknesses.title: Map/Mode Dependant Tank
weaknesses.description: Whilst the leo1a6 can perform well, this can be highly dependant on the game map and mode. Leo1a6 commanders who find themselves sucked into modes or maps without the opportunity to set up will find the match challenging.

weaknesses.title: Poor Gun Handling
weaknesses.description: The Leo1a6 suffers from weak soft stats. For a sniper it can spend a long time waiting for its gun to stabilise. A lengthy aim time and significant dispersion while moving means Leo1a6 players may find quick shots frustrating, especially if caught on the move.

tank_summary: The Leopard 1A6A1 is the quintessential glass-cannon sniper, built around exceptional single-shot damage and the ability to influence battles from extreme range. Armed with a devastating cannon and backed by strong mobility, it excels at repositioning across the battlefield, finding firing lanes, and punishing exposed enemies with heavy alpha strikes.

Its toolkit offers a blend of utility and deception. Decoys can be used to mislead opponents, bait shots, create temporary cover, or simply sow confusion amongst enemy teams. Meanwhile, It's trapping shots allow players to both immobilise tanks and strip away shields to create opportunities for devastating follow-up attacks. When fully upgraded, its abilities become particularly lethal, allowing skilled commanders to combine Trapping Shot and its execution-style Ultimate to eliminate even heavily armoured vehicles instantly.

However, the Leopard pays heavily for its offensive power. It possesses a low health pool, virtually no meaningful armour protection, and a vulnerable frontal ammo rack that further compromises its survivability. Its gun handling is also unforgiving, with poor soft stats and a lengthy aim time punishing rushed shots. Every missed shot carries significant consequences. In the right hands and on maps that favour long-range combat, the Leopard 1A6A1 is one of the most dangerous vehicles on the battlefield. But when caught out of position, it can disappear just as quickly as it strikes.
